dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Trailing edge follows a slight concave spline from the dorsal ridge to the apex, interrupted by a small notch near the mid-section.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: The apex is blunt and rounded with a wide pixel radius, categorized as obtuse.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: The anterior margin presents a straight line at approximately 50-55 degrees relative to the horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximate 1.1:1 ratio of maximum base width to vertical height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: The melon displays a smooth, convex curvature with a moderate radius arc visible despite high exposure.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short and stout rostrum extending from the melon inflection point with a low length-to-width ratio.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: A discernible inflection point is present where the melon's downward slope meets the rostrum's base at an obtuse angle.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible notch on the trailing edge of the dorsal fin; dark circular mark on the lateral flank below the dorsal insertion.
other_distinctive_markers: Entire visible skin surface displays a lack of typical pigmentation, appearing uniformly white/pale.
